blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI-generated text detectors are increasingly deployed in consequential settings---peer review, education, admissions, journalism, and content moderation---where their outputs directly affect individuals. Yet the strongest detectors are fine-tuned neural classifiers whose decisions are opaque, while transparent alternatives (stylometric and linguistic-feature classifiers) underperform them by wide margins. We present a pipeline that converts a fine-tuned neural detector into a classifier that operates on human-readable concepts. We accomplish this by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) directly on a detector's residual stream, assigning auto-interpretation labels to each SAE feature, and retaining only features whose generated descriptions pass a global fidelity threshold. We then train a lightweight classifier on just the interpretable features. We find that our SAEs recover latent concepts that correspond to highly specific and predictive linguistic "tells" of AI-generated text. Classifiers built on these extracted features are not only highly interpretable but exhibit stronger performance on out-of-distribution texts than either neural or stylometric alternatives.
blocks.zh: AI生成的文本探测器越来越多地被部署在相应的环境中 -- -- 同行审查、教育、录取、新闻和内容节制 -- -- 其产出直接影响到个人。 然而最强的探测器是微调的神经分级器,其决定不透明,而透明的替代方法(时态和语言特征分级器)则以宽边差来使其表现不佳. 我们提出一个管道,将一个微调神经探测器转换成一个在人可读概念上运作的分类器. 我们通过直接在探测器的剩余流上培训稀少的自动编码器来完成这项工作,为每个自动编码器的特性分配自动解释标签,并只保留其生成的描述超过全球忠诚阈值的特性。 然后,我们训练一个轻量级分类器 仅关于可解释的特性。 我们发现,我们的SAE恢复了潜在的概念,这些概念与AI生成的文本中高度具体和预测的语言"提"相对应. 以这些取出的特点为基础的分类器不仅具有高度的可解释性,而且在分配外文本上的性能也比神经或分型的替代品要强。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: AI-generated text detection is no longer a purely academic problem. Detectors are used to flag student essays, vet peer-review submissions, screen job applications, and moderate online content. Their outputs feed into decisions that affect individuals, and in practice they are often treated as black boxes by users who cannot inspect or contest them.
blocks.zh: AI生成的文本检测不再是纯粹的学术问题. 检测器用于标注学生论文,审查同行评审提交材料,筛选工作申请,以及适度在线内容. 其产出为影响个人的决定提供了投入,实际上,这些产出往往被无法检查或质疑的用户视为黑盒。

blocks.en: Figure 1: In our work, we use Sparse Autoencoders to convert existing black box AI detectors into ones that operate on human-interpretable concepts—allowing for more auditable deployment.
blocks.zh: 图1:在我们的工作中,我们使用Sparse自动编码器将现有的黑盒AI探测器转换成操作于人可解释概念的探测器——允许进行更多的可审计部署。

blocks.en:
In settings like these, accuracy is not the only thing that matters. What also matters is whether an auditor—a reviewer, an instructor, a compliance officer—can look inside a decision, understand what the detector is keying on, and stress-test it. Stylometric detectors ( Fröhling and Zubiaga, 2021 ; Aityan et al., 2026 ) are interpretable by construction but underperform their neural counterparts. Fine-tuned neural models achieve high accuracy but operate as black boxes.
What real-world deployment needs is a performant AI detector whose decisions can be explained and grounded in specific characteristics and features of the input text.
blocks.zh:
在这样的环境下,准确性并非唯一重要的东西. 同样重要的是,审计员——一名审查员、一名教员、一名督察干事——是否能够在决定内看一看,了解探测器在按什么键,并测试其压力。 造型探测器(Fröhling and Zubiaga, 2021;Aityan et al, 2026)可以通过构造来解释,但对其神经对应物的表现不佳. 精细的神经模型实现高精度但作为黑匣子运行.
现实世界的部署需要的是一个表演的AI探测器,它的决定可以被解释和基于输入文本的具体特征和特征.

blocks.en: Our work builds an interpretable AI detector in four stages. First, we fine-tune a model on the AI detection task. Then, we train sparse autoencoders on the model’s residual stream at various depths. Then, we run an auto-interpretation pipeline on the SAE features ( Bills et al., 2023 ; Paulo et al., 2025 ) , and keep only those features whose explanations reach a certain global simulation score threshold. Finally, we train a lightweight L 1 L_{1} -regularized logistic regression classifier on the remaining features. The resulting classifier is built on automatically discovered features that each have an associated natural-language description that accurately describes their underlying activation patterns.

blocks.en: 2.2 Automatically Interpreting SAE Features
blocks.zh: 2.2 自动解释 SAE 特性

blocks.en: Auto-interpretation Bills et al. (2023) ; Paulo et al. (2025) is the act of generating human-readable descriptions of SAE features given their activations on a large corpus. A typical pipeline for this is as follows: For each feature, sample a small representative set of documents from across the feature’s activation distribution. Then, provide these documents to a large language model and ask it to generate a short human-readable description of that feature (typically 10-20 tokens).
blocks.zh: 自动口译 Bills等人(2023年),Paulo等人(2025年),鉴于SAE特征在大体上的激活,是产生人类可读描述的行为. 这方面的一个典型管道如下: 为每个功能,从功能激活分布中抽取一小套具有代表性的文件。 然后,将这些文件提供给一个大语言模型,并要求它生成一个对该特征的简短的人类可读描述(一般为10-20个符).

blocks.en: Once a description is generated, the model is then asked to validate the accuracy of the description by “simulating” the neuron—predicting on which tokens of an arbitrary input text the feature is active—given only the generated description. The resulting correlation score between the true activations and simulated activations measures how faithfully the feature’s description represents its true behavior.

blocks.en: 2.3 SAEs for Hypothesis Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 假设生成的超临界排放效应

blocks.en: Recent work has begun to investigate SAEs not just as ways of uncovering information about the internal activations of language models but also as ways of generating hypotheses about textual classification tasks in an unsupervised manner Movva et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 最近的工作已经开始调查SAE, 不仅作为发现语言模型内部激活信息的方法, 也作为产生关于文字分类任务的假设的方法,

blocks.en: For example, say an SAE feature fires disproportionately on a particular class in a classification task. That feature may represent a semantically meaningful and predictive aspect of the class. In their work, Movva et al. (2025) found SAE features such as “mentions being surprised or shocked” that were positively predictive of news engagement and “mentions issues related to food safety” that were negatively predictive of restaurant rating.
blocks.zh: 例如,在分类任务中,一个SAE的特点是对某一特定类别产生不成比例的火灾。 这一特征可能代表了这一类中一个具有实质意义和预测性的方面。 Movva等人(2025年)在他们的工作中发现,SAE的特征,如对新闻参与作出积极预测的“感知或震惊”和对餐馆评级作出消极预测的“与食品安全有关的感知问题”。

blocks.en: Broadly speaking, this concept of using interpretability as a “microscope” Olah (2015) to illuminate interesting aspects of underlying data distributions is a strong undercurrent of our work. We follow this line of work by uncovering specific predictive linguistic cues of AI generated text and show that these tells create strong classifiers.
blocks.zh: 广义地说,使用可解释性作为“显微镜”Olah(2015年)来阐明基本数据分布的有趣方面的概念是我们工作的一个很强的底线。 我们通过发现AI生成的文字的具体预测语言提示来遵循这一条工作线,并显示这些提示可以产生强大的分类器.

The result is a detector that retains the strength of the original neural model while being composed of auditable and intervenable human-understandable concepts.
blocks.zh: 图2:我们的管道。 从一个精细的AI文本检测器开始,我们用四层的剩余流对SAE进行训练,用自动对讲解释来标记每个潜伏层,掩盖所有不符合我们全球阈值的特性,并训练一个轻量级的分类器来比照其余的概念. 结果是一种探测器,它保留了原始神经模型的强度,同时由可审计和可互通的人类可理解的概念组成.

blocks.en: 3 Related Work
blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en: Early work on explainable AI detectors primarily centered around distributional analysis of linguistic features Fröhling and Zubiaga (2021) ; Uchendu et al. (2020) ; Zahid et al. (2024) ; Zaitsu et al. (2025) . Follow-up work refined this to include discourse features Kim et al. (2024) ; Russell et al. (2026) dependency parses Ahmed and Hammond (2026) ngram overlaps Koike et al. (2026) and ensembles Aityan et al. (2026) . However, AI detectors built on these linguistic features generally underperform black-box counterparts and are limited in their ability to generalize to adversarial or out-of-distribution inputs Schuster et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh: 关于可解释的AI探测器的早期工作主要围绕对语言特征Fröhling和Zubiaga的分布分析(2021);Uchendu等人(2020);Zahid等人(2024);Zaitsu等人(2025)。 后续行动改进了这项工作,使之包括讨论内容 Kim 等人(2024年); Russell 等人(2026年) 依赖 parses Ahmed 和 Hammond(2026年) ngram 重叠 Koike 等人(2026年) 和 tempbles Aityan 等人(2026年). 然而,基于这些语言特征的AI探测器一般表现不佳的黑匣子对应器,其通俗化能力也有限,只能用于对抗性或分散性输入Shuster等人(2020年).

blocks.en: On the other hand, fine-tuned neural classifiers Solaiman et al. (2019) , and other zero-shot likelihood-based metrics Mitchell et al. (2023) ; Hans et al. (2024) exhibit surprisingly strong in-distribution performance and much better generalization than their stylometric counterparts Dugan et al. (2025) ; Sandhan et al. (2026) . Previous work used techniques like LIME Ribeiro et al. (2016) and SHAP Lundberg and Lee (2017) to interpret these neural models Shah et al. (2023) ; Schoenegger et al. (2026) but such explanations only give global token-level importance scores and fail to provide rationales as to why particular tokens are predictive. Our work is the first to go beyond these token-based attribution scores and create a fully interpretable AI detection system that maintains the strong performance of neural models.
blocks.zh: 另一方面,微调神经分类器Solaiman等人(2019年),以及其他基于零镜头概率的度量. 米切尔等人(2023年);汉斯等人. 2024年的分布性能出人意料地强劲,概括性要好于其时态对应的Dugan等人(2025年);Sandhan等人(2026年)。 之前的作品使用了LIME Ribeiro等人(2016年)和SHAP Lundberg和Lee(2017年)等技术来解释这些神经模型. Shah等人(2023年); Schoenegger等人(2026年),但这种解释只给出了全球信使级别的重要性分数,未能提供某些信使为何具有预测性的理由. 我们的工作是第一个超越这些基于符号的归属分数,并创建一个完全可解释的AI检测系统,保持神经模型的强性能.

blocks.en: L 1 L_{1} -regularized linear classifiers (“sparse probes”) trained on SAE features were first proposed as diagnostic tools for measuring monosemanticity Gurnee et al. (2023) ; Gao et al. (2025) . Follow up work showed that such classifiers perform on par with (but no better than) dense linear probes Bricken et al. (2024) ; Kantamneni et al. (2025) . Our work follows Peng et al. (2026) in claiming that interpretability, not accuracy, is the primary benefit of these classifiers.
blocks.zh: L 1 L_{1} - 接受过SAE特征培训的正规线性分类器(“Sparse Protects”)首先被提议作为测量单体抗体Gurnee等人(2023年)的诊断工具;Gao等人(2025年)。 后续工作显示,这种分类器的性能与Bricken等人(2024年);Kantamneni等人(2025年)的密集线性探测器相同。 我们的工作跟随彭等人(2026年),声称可解释性而非准确性是这些分类者的主要好处.

blocks.en: In this vein, recent work has shown that classifiers trained on SAE features are useful as interpretable reward models Zhang et al. (2026) , dense retrievers Park et al. (2025) , hallucination detectors Xiong et al. (2026) , and LLM-as-judge systems Wedgwood et al. (2026) . However, these works all provide the full set of SAE features as input to the downstream classifiers without any explicit removal of high density or polysemantic SAE latents Sun et al. (2025) ; Chanin et al. (2025) . The lack of such filtering undermines the faithfulness of the system-level explanations.
blocks.zh: 因此,最近的研究表明,接受过SAE特性培训的分类人员作为可解释的奖励模式是有用的。 张等人(2026年),密集的检索器 朴 al等人著. (2025),幻觉探测器. Xiong等人(2026年),以及LLM-as-judge系统 Wedgwood等人(2026年). 然而,这些作品都提供了完整的一套SAE特征,作为下游分类器的输入,而没有明确去除高密度或多语种SAE潜在Sun等人(2025年);Chain等人(2025年). 缺乏这种过滤损害了系统层面解释的忠实性。

blocks.en: To combat this, Kulkarni et al. (2026) proposed to remove the M M least interpretable SAE features from their classifier. However, this does not guarantee that the remaining features are themselves interpretable. Our work is the first to propose a global filtering threshold based on auto-interpretability score to ensure our explanations are faithful to the underlying dynamics of our classifier.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,Kulkarni等人(2026年)提议从他们的分类器中删除M M最不易解释的SAE特性。 然而,这并不能保证剩余特征本身是可以解释的。 我们的工作是第一个根据自动解释性分数提出全球过滤阈值,以确保我们的解释忠实于我们分类者的基本动态。

blocks.en: Previous work by Scher (2024) noted the potential for SAEs as a means of interpreting AI detectors. They trained a lightweight classifier on SAE features of GPT-2 Small and found that they outperformed stylometric features in AI detection. Follow-up work by Kuznetsov et al. (2025) looked at how SAE features of Gemma-2-2B co-occurred with AI generated text. However, neither of these works train their own SAE models on AI detectors, nor do they evaluate the accuracy of the provided feature descriptions. Our work is the first to train SAEs directly on AI detectors and is the first to propose using these features as an interpretable AI detector.
blocks.zh: Scher以前的工作(2024年)指出了SAEs作为解释AI探测器的一种手段的潜力. 他们在GPT-2 Small的SAE特性上训练了一个轻量级分类器,发现它们在AI检测中的表现超过了时态特征. Kuznetsov等人的后续工作 (2025)研究了Gemma-2-2B的SAE特性如何与AI共同生成文本. 然而,这些作品都没有在AI探测器上训练自己的SAE模型,也没有评价所提供的特征描述的准确性. 我们的作品是第一部直接对AI探测器进行SAE训练的作品,也是第一部提出使用这些特性作为可解释的AI探测器的作品.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: 5.1 Data
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据

blocks.en: In this setting we train the model to detect AI generated text from an arbitrary AI model in an arbitrary domain. We train our models on the English split of the COLING shared task dataset Wang et al. (2025) a collection spanning 41 highly diverse language models paired with human texts. We use the official train and dev splits (610k and 261k documents) for training and in-distribution testing. For evaluating out-of-distribution generalization we use the official english devtest and test splits of the COLING dataset as well as the non-adversarial test split of the RAID leaderboard Dugan et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 在此设定中,我们训练模型以检测AI从任意的AI模型中生成的文本在一个任意的域中. 我们训练我们的模型 关于英语分割 COLING共享任务数据集 王等人。 (2025年) 藏品涵盖41种高度多样化的语言模式,与人类文本配对. 我们使用正式列车和dev拆分(610k和261k文件)进行训练和分配测试. 在评估分配外一般化时,我们使用COLING数据集的官方英文版本的测试分解以及RAID领导板Dugan等人的非对抗性测试分解(2024年)。

blocks.en: For our closed setting we fine-tune models to detect AI generated academic peer reviews using the Peer Review Detection Benchmark (PRDB) Yu et al. (2026) . This contains 106,413 human-written peer reviews for the NeurIPS and ICLR conferences for years 2016-2024 along with paired AI generated texts. For training we use the extended split and separate it into two sets: Human vs. GPT-4o and Human vs. Llama-3.1-70B. For evaluation we use the combined calibration and test splits, which contain held out human texts and paired generations from GPT-4o, Llama 3.1 70B, Qwen 2.5 72B, Claude Sonnet 3.5, and Gemini 1.5 Pro.
blocks.zh: 我们用同行审议检测基准(PRDB)Yu et al. (2026年), 其中包括106,413份2016-2024年NeurIPS和ICLR会议的人文同行评审以及配对AI生成的文本. 在训练方面,我们使用扩展的拆分并分成两组:Human vs. GPT-4o和Human vs. Llama-31-70B. 为了评估,我们使用结合校准和测试分数,其中包含GPT-4o、Llama 3.1 70B、Quen 2.5 72B、Claude Sonnet 3.5和双子座1.5 Pro的人类文本和对代。

blocks.en: 5.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 5.2 基线

blocks.en: For our neural baseline we fine-tune the gemma-2-2B model for the AI detection task. We replace the language modeling head with a classification head and train to minimize binary cross-entropy on the AI detection task. We verify that our neural model outperforms the baseline RoBERTa model from the COLING shared task Wang et al. (2025) on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution texts. Full training details can be found in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 为了我们的神经基线,我们微调了Gemma-2-2B模型,用于AI检测任务. 我们用分类头和列车取代语言模型头,以尽量减少AI检测任务上的二进制交叉切入. 我们核实,我们的神经模型在分配文本和分配文本两方面都超过了COLING WAN等人(2025年)共同任务的基准RoBERTa模型。 培训详情见附录B。

blocks.en: For our stylometric baseline we fine-tune a L 1 L_{1} -regularized Logistic Regression classifier on document embeddings produced by gram2vec Zeng et al. (2025) . These embeddings contain over 930 features from seven linguistic categories: punctuation marks, parts of speech, morphology tags, dependency labels, function words, emojis, and transition words. These features have been shown to outperform Biber features Biber (1988) for both authorship attribution and AI detection.

blocks.en: 5.3 Models
blocks.zh: 5.3 模式

blocks.en: Our models are built off of GemmaScope Lieberum et al. (2024) , a collection of pre-trained SAEs trained to reconstruct activations of gemma-2-2b on arbitrary text. For our core comparisons we do the following: 1. Base-SAE : Use the pre-trained GemmaScope SAEs without any additional fine-tuning. 2. FT-SAE : Fine-tune the GemmaScope SAEs to better reconstruct base gemma-2-2b’s model activations on in-domain examples from the AI detection task. 3. FT-Model+SAE : Fine-tune gemma-2-2b for AI detection, then fine-tune GemmaScope SAEs to reconstruct the fine-tuned model’s activations on in-domain examples from the AI detection task. To train our SAEs we cache raw activations for all tokens in the training corpus and uniformly shuffle batches across all tokens in the dataset. For more details on our training procedure see Appendix A .

blocks.en: 6 Findings
blocks.zh: 6 调查结果

blocks.en: In Table 1 we report the results of our detector models on the in-distribution dev split and the three held out out-of-distribution test splits for the COLING dataset. We find that in all three cases, the FT-Model+SAE condition matches the AUC and F1 score performance of the full AI detector—only losing ground once we restrict to lower false positive rate. Furthermore, when restricting to highly interpretable features ( τ > 0.7 \tau>0.7 ), our FT-Model+SAE system is still able to recover (and even improve) the performance of the full model despite only having a fraction of the features unmasked.
blocks.zh: 在表1中,我们汇报了我们的探测器模型对COLING数据集的分布式dev分裂和三个分布式外部测试分裂的结果。 我们发现,在所有三种情况下,FT-Model+SAE条件都与全AI探测器的AUC和F1分数性能相匹配——一旦我们限制降低虚假的正率,只会失利。 此外,在限制高度可解释的特性(τ > 0.7\tau > 0.7)时,我们的FT-Model+SAE系统仍然能够恢复(甚至改进)整个模型的性能,尽管只有一小部分特性没有被遮盖。

blocks.en: However, when the underlying detector fails to generalize, so too does our system. In Figure 4 we see that FT-Model+SAE underperforms our two base model systems by fairly wide margins on out-of-distribution data. As we will discuss in the next section, the surprising aspect of this is the strong performance of these base model systems, not the failure of the FT-Model+SAE system to surpass the performance of the underlying detector it was trained on.
blocks.zh: 然而,当基础探测器未能概括,我们的系统也是如此。 在图4中,我们看到FT-Model+SAE在分配外数据上以相当宽的边距来削弱我们的两个基本模型系统。 正如我们将在下一节讨论的那样,这令人惊讶的方面是这些基础模型系统的强效性能,而不是FT-Model+SAE系统未能超越它所训练的基础探测器的性能.

blocks.en: In Table 1 we see that Base-SAE and FT-SAE perform very well, especially when applied to out-of-distribution data—beating well established baselines such as Binoculars Hans et al. (2024) and FastDetectGPT Bao et al. (2024) by around 8-12 F1 score. This is especially surprising for the Base-SAE condition, as the only trainable parameters in the system are the logistic regression weights.
blocks.zh: 在表1中,我们看到Base-SAE和FT-SAE的表现非常好,特别是在分配数据方面——比诺望远镜Hans等人(2024年)和快速探测GPT Bao等人(2024年)等既定基准比分大约为8-12 F1。 对于Base-SAE条件来说,这特别令人吃惊,因为系统中唯一可以训练的参数是后勤回归权重.

blocks.en: 7 Paraphrase Ablation
blocks.zh: 7 释义

blocks.en: In the previous section we established that our detectors are highly accurate. However, we still need to provide causal evidence that our feature descriptions faithfully represent the underlying dynamics of the model beyond simple auto-interpretation scores. We do this in two ways: a feature-level paraphrase ablation and a document-level ablation. 4 4 4 For an extended analysis of both experiments along with examples and more plots, see Appendix E .

blocks.en: 7.1 Feature-Level Paraphrase Ablation
blocks.zh: 7.1 特征-水平参数

blocks.en: In this experiment we want to ablate individual features and observe whether the change in downstream prediction matches what our pipeline expects. To do this we start by subsampling 500 human and 500 AI documents from both COLING and PRDB. For a given model, we run a forward pass on all documents and get all active features that contribute to the downstream prediction. For each feature we do a targeted paraphrase; we feed the text description of that feature to gemini-3.1-flash-lite and ask it to paraphrase the document to remove only that feature. We report correlation between the mean paraphrase ablated logit delta and the mean importance score per feature. If our pipeline is faithful, then the downstream logit effect of paraphrasing away a feature will exactly equal the importance score of that feature.
blocks.zh: 在这个实验中,我们想降低单个特征, 观察下游预测的变化 是否与我们的管道所期望的相符。 为了做到这一点,我们首先对来自COLING和PRDB的500个人类和500个AI文件进行子样本. 对于一个特定的模型,我们对所有文件进行向前传递,并获得有助于下游预测的所有积极特征。 对于每个特性,我们都会做一个目标明确的解释;我们将该特性的文字描述输入到gemini-3.1-flash-lite,并请它来解释文档,只删除该特性。 我们报告平均参数三角洲和每个特征的平均重要性之比之间的关联。 如果我们的输油管是忠实的,那么从下游的逻辑效应中去掉一个特征将完全等同于该特征的重要性。

blocks.en: 7.2 Document-Level Paraphrase Ablation
blocks.zh: 7.2 文件级参数

blocks.en: In this experiment we want to show that the set of features given by our pipeline in aggregate represent all of the features used by the model to make its prediction. To do this we conduct an adversarial humanization attack. We start by sampling 2,500 AI documents from both datasets. For each document we query gemini-3.1-flash-lite with five different prompts to get five different paraphrases. The first prompt “Baseline” simply asks the model to rewrite the text to make it more human. The second “Few Shot” includes few shot examples of human documents from the train split of the dataset. The “Guided” prompt includes instructions with features that are colloquially associated with AI and explicitly asks to remove them.
blocks.zh: 在这个实验中,我们想表明,我们管道在整体上给出的一组特征代表了模型用于预测的所有特征. 为了做到这一点,我们进行对抗性的人性化攻击。 我们首先从两个数据集的2500个AI文件取样. 对于每个文档,我们用五个不同的提示来查询Gemini-3.1-flash-lite,以获得五个不同的参数。 第一个提示的“Baseline”只是要求模型重写文本,使其更加人性化。 第二部“Few Shot”包括了从列车拆分数据集中拍摄的人类文件的几个例子。 “指导性”提示包括一些与大赦国际有口味联系并明确要求删除的指示。

blocks.en: The final two prompts explicitly use our system. The “SAE” prompt includes the list of active features with their associated descriptions and importances and asks the model to remove all AI features. Finally, the “SAE x3” prompt iterates over the “SAE” prompt three times, re-querying the pipeline for the new most active features each time. We do each of these once per model condition. All prompts explicitly tell the model to edit less than 30% of tokens in the document.
blocks.zh: 最后两个提示明确使用我们的系统。 “SAE”提示包括了活动特征清单及其相关描述和重要性,并要求该模型删除所有AI特征。 最后,“SAE x3”催促在“SAE”催促下三次重置,每次重新填充管道,以开发最活跃的新特性。 我们每个模型都做一次 所有提示都明确告诉模型在文档中编辑不到30%的令牌.

blocks.en: In Figure 5 we report the results of the adversarial humanization. We see that our interpretable detectors are surprisingly robust to humanizing paraphrases, with the baseline flipping at most 8.7% of the documents’ predictions and frequently 0%. Next, we see that including our pipeline’s interpretable features improves flip rate substantially more than either of the generic prompts across all models. Allowing the model to iterate further increases this gap, with a success rate of 60-100% across all conditions all while maintaining a low edit distance (<40% of tokens in the document edited). While it is not definitive proof, this result does suggest that our lists of features are relatively complete and high recall—paraphrasing away existing features flips predictions rather than revealing new AI features.
blocks.zh: 在图5中,我们报告了对抗性人性化的结果。 我们发现,我们的可解释探测器令人惊讶地强大起来,能够使解释人性化,基线翻转率高达文件预测的8.7%,而且经常为0 %。 接下来,我们看到,包括我们管道的可解释性能,比所有模型的任何一个通用提示都提高了翻转率。 允许该模型进一步增加这一差距,在所有条件下的成功率为60-100%,同时保持低编辑距离(在编辑的文件中的符号为 < 40%)。 虽然这不是确凿的证据,但这一结果确实表明,我们的特征清单比较完整,而且具有很高的召回性——删除现有的特征会推翻预测,而不是揭示新的AI特征。

blocks.en: 8 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 8 定性分析

blocks.en: In Table 4 we list the most predictive features for FT-Model+SAE ( τ > 0.85 ) (\tau>0.85) on AI Peer Reviews, ranked by mean feature importance score (Logit Δ \Delta ). We report the top features pushing the detector towards GPT-4o and Llama (positive Logit Δ \Delta ) as well as those pushing towards Human (negative Logit Δ \Delta ). Extended tables covering all three systems on both PRDB and COLING can be found in Tables 26 through 34 in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: 在表4中,我们在AI同行审评中列出了FT-Model+SAE(\tau>0.85)的最预测特征,按平均特征重要性分(Logit \\\Delta)排序。 我们报告将探测器推向GPT-4o和Llama(阳性Logit QQ\Delta)以及推向Human(阴性Logit QQ\Delta)的功能。 涵盖PRDB和COLING三个系统的扩展表载于附录表26至表34。

blocks.en: We first note that the most predictive features are highly specific, frequently activating on only one or two tokens or on formatting characters and punctuation marks. For example, feature 22_4800 (“double colons following bolded markdown section headers”) appears in only 11 human documents but over 54,000 GPT-4o documents, and feature 13_164 (“opening square bracket in list or string literals”) appears in just 7 human documents but over 22,000 Llama documents.
blocks.zh: 我们首先指出,最有预测性的特征非常具体,常常只激活一两个符号或格式化字符和标点符号。 例如,特征22_4800(“粗体标注部分标题之后的双冒号”)仅出现在11份人类文件中,但超过54,000 GPT-4o文档,特征13_164(“打开列表中的方括号或字符串文字”)仅出现在7份人类文件中,但超过22,000份Llama文档。

blocks.en: In addition, we observe that the most predictive features for human text are largely stylistic rather than structural: first person pronouns at the start of sentences (13_5785), hedges such as “seem” or “seems” used to express an opinion (7_10672), and the word “see” used as a directive to look elsewhere in the review (7_1616). The extended tables reveal further differences between systems: on COLING, the top FT-SAE feature (13_3738) activates on “introductory phrases or filler text commonly used by ai language models when declining personal questions” ( e.g., “As an AI language model”), while the top Base-SAE features are dominated by topical and domain-level signals such as HTML attributes and software license boilerplate. This suggests that detectors built on base model representations may rely more heavily on domain shortcuts than on stylistic properties of the text itself.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还注意到,人类文本的最预测性特征主要是结构化而非结构化的:句子开头的第一人称代词(13_5785),用于表达观点的“外观”或“外观”等套线(7_10672),以及在审查(7_1616)中用作查看其他地方的指示的“外观”一词。 扩展的表格揭示了系统之间的进一步差异:在COLING上,FT-SAE的顶端功能(13_3738)在“Ai语言模型在降低个人问题时常用的介绍性短语或填充文本”(例如“作为AI语言模型”)上激活,而顶端的Base-SAE功能则以HTML属性和软件许可锅炉板等主题和域级信号为主. 这表明基于基模型表示的探测器可能更依赖域捷径,而不是文本本身的风格特性.

blocks.en: Given the near perfect performance of these models at detecting AI-generated peer reviews (Section 6 ), one could reasonably claim that such features are spurious and should not be used in detection. In their analysis, Kantamneni et al. (2025) claimed as much, and recommended all formatting based features be removed. However, it is unclear what should and should not be considered a spurious feature for the purposes of AI detection. If a formatting quirk is consistently present in AI-written text across contexts, there’s a good argument to be made that it should be included. Ultimately, the ability for a model provider to audit and decide on a case-by-case basis whether or not a particular feature should be used by a particular AI detector is a key affordance of our system.
blocks.zh: 鉴于这些模型在检测人工智能生成的同行审评方面几乎完美无缺(第6节),人们可以合理地声称这些特征是虚假的,不应用于检测。 在分析中,Kantamneni等人(2025年)声称同样多,建议删除所有基于格式的特征. 然而,对于AI检测目的而言,什么应当、什么不应当被认为是虚假的特征,这一点尚不清楚。 如果一种格式化的怪异语在各种背景的AI书面文本中始终存在,那么就有一个很好的论点,即应该包括它。 归根结底,模型提供者逐个审计和决定某一AI检测器是否应该使用某一特性的能力是我们系统的关键。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: In order to be able to use AI detectors in real-world high-stakes situations, they need to be auditable. It is unreasonable to expect major decisions to be made at the behest of an AI detector that cannot provide a rationale for its output. Current interpretable stylometric AI detectors underperform state-of-the-art neural AI detection methods by wide margins—making them infeasible for widespread use.
blocks.zh: 为了能够在现实世界的高收盘情况下使用AI探测器,它们需要具有可审计性. 期望在AI探测器的指使下作出无法为其产出提供理由的重大决定是不合理的。 目前可解释的型号AI探测器表现不佳,其最先进的神经AI探测方法很广,使其无法广泛使用。

blocks.en: In this paper we propose a technique to take an existing black box neural AI detector and convert it into a detector that operates on human-interpretable concepts. We accomplish this by training Sparse Autoencoders on the detector’s residual stream and training a lightweight classifier over only the features that pass a given global interpretability threshold. We find that classifiers constructed in this way retain the performance and generalization properties of the underlying base model while being substantially more understandable. Extensive ablations show that our feature descriptions have high recall and high precision, faithfully representing what the features fire on and how they contribute to the final prediction.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出一种技术,将现有的黑匣子神经元AI检测器转换成在人可解释的概念上运行的检测器. 我们通过训练Sparse自动编码器在探测器的剩余流上, 我们发现,以这种方式构建的分类器保留了基础模型的性能和概括性,同时明显地更容易理解。 大量的浮雕表明,我们的特点描述具有很高的回忆力和高度精确性,忠实地代表了特征的火力和如何促进最后预测。

blocks.en: In addition to this, we find that classifiers based on SAE decompositions of base model activations are surprisingly robust detectors of AI generated text. We find that they outperform strong well-established baselines in the AI detection literature and encourage future work to follow up with further experimentation on using internal activations of language models as input to AI detectors.
blocks.zh: 除此之外,我们发现基于SAE分解基模型激活的分类器是AI生成文本的惊人的强力探测器. 我们发现,它们在AI检测文献中的表现超过了牢固的既定基线,并鼓励今后进一步开展关于利用内部激活语言模型作为AI检测器投入的实验。

blocks.en: Finally, we analyze the features used by AI detectors and find that they frequently use highly specific token sequences and formatting elements which may fail to generalize to other domains and models. Our findings raise questions about which features are valid to use in an AI detection system and we encourage future work to investigate adversarial hardening techniques using this style of unsupervised concept discovery.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们分析AI探测器所使用的特性,发现它们经常使用高度具体的符号序列和格式化元素,这些元素可能无法概括到其他域和模型中. 我们的调查结果提出了在AI检测系统中哪些特征是有效的问题,我们鼓励今后的工作利用这种不受监督的概念发现方式来调查对抗性硬化技术。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: One core limitation of our work is a limitation shared by the current literature, namely that auto-interpretation pipelines systematically produce descriptions that are high recall but low precision Gao et al. (2025) . For example, say an SAE feature fires on the token “Tom” but only after the token “Hello”. If our dataset only ever contains the token “Tom” in this context, then our pipeline will likely generate a description for this feature that misses the dependency. That same description would also receive a perfect auto-interpretation score by the validation pipeline for the same reason.
blocks.zh: 我们工作的一个核心限制是现有文献的共同限制,即自动解释管道系统地产生高召回但低精度的描述(2025年)。 例如,说一个SAE在符号“Tom”上放火,但只在符号“Hello”之后放火。 如果我们的数据集只包含这个语境中的“Tom”符号,那么我们的编审程序就有可能对这一特征产生缺失依赖性的描述。 出于同样的原因,这一描述也将得到验证管道的完美自动解释分数。

blocks.en: In their work, Gao et al. (2025) attempt to measure the effect size of this issue using Neuron2Graph explanations Foote et al. (2023) targeting specific ngrams in the training corpus. We attempted something similar in an informal capacity and asked language models to generate regular expressions that matched the generated description of a subset of our features. We measured the precision and recall using the regular expression as a ground truth and found that, while roughly half of our features did manage to get perfect descriptions (99.5+ F1 score), the other half exhibited this same recall bias to varying degrees. We believe that better sampling of hard negatives and synthetic data generation are good potential avenues to reduce this issue.
blocks.zh: 在他们的工作中,Gao等人(2025年)试图使用Neuron2Graph解释Foote等人来测量这个问题的影响大小. (2023年)针对培训教程中的具体ngm. 我们以非正式身份尝试类似的东西,并要求语言模型生成与我们的一个子集的生成描述相符的正则表达式。 我们用正则表达法来测量精确度和回想,并发现,虽然我们大约一半的特征确实得到了完美的描述(99.5+F1分),但另一半在不同程度上表现出同样的回想偏差。 我们认为,更好地取样硬底片和合成数据是减少这一问题的良好潜在途径。

blocks.en: Another limitation of our work is the fact that we only test on fine-tuned GemmaScope SAEs and do not train SAEs on other base models. While other trained SAEs do exist for models like Llama and Qwen, we chose GemmaScope as it is by far the most popular and was used by previous work for AI detection Kuznetsov et al. (2025) . Future work should seek to expand the breadth of base models tested, especially as it relates to the performance of the Base-SAE and FT-SAE conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们工作的另一个局限是,我们只测试精细的GemmaScope SAEs,而不在其他基模型上培训SAEs. 虽然其他训练有素的SAE确实存在像Llama和Quen这样的型号,但我们选择了GemmaScope,因为它是迄今为止最受欢迎的,被之前的AI探测库兹涅佐夫等人(2025年)的作品所使用. 今后的工作应力求扩大所测试的基本模型的广度,特别是因为它涉及Base-SAE和FT-SAE条件的性能。

blocks.en: We use the JumpReLU SAE Rajamanoharan et al. (2024) architecture and rescale 𝐖 dec \mathbf{W}_{\text{dec}} rows to unit norm after each update. blocks.en: When constructing batches for inference we want to uniformly shuffle tokens across different documents to avoid training instability. However, actually implementing this requires caching activations on the entire dataset, which requires a large amount of disk space.
blocks.zh: 在构建批量推论时,我们希望在不同文件之间统一洗牌以避免训练不稳定。 然而,实际执行这需要在整个数据集进行缓存激活,这需要大量的磁盘空间.

blocks.en: To implement this, we first sample a pool of documents and bin them according to sequence length. We then run model inference on these batches and extract the per-token activations at each layer. We load these activations into an activations buffer and shuffle that buffer uniformly before sampling batches for inference. Using a buffer of 1,000,000 tokens results in a reasonably uniform shuffle across token sequences during inference without requiring us to cache activations.
blocks.zh: 为了执行这一点,我们首先抽取了一批文件,然后按照序列长度将其嵌入。 然后我们对这些批次进行模型推论 并提取每层每层的活化量 我们把这些激活器加载到一个激活器缓冲器中,在采样批次进行推论之前,统一洗涤缓冲器. 使用100万令牌的缓冲器,在推论期间可以合理统一地对令牌序列进行洗牌,而不需要我们缓存激活.

blocks.en: To speed up training and save time caching activations, we trained all SAEs for all layers of a given model simultaneously. This limited the need for many costly forward passes of the base model.
blocks.zh: 为了加快训练并节省时间缓存激活,我们同时为特定模型的所有层都培训了所有SAE. 这限制了许多代价高昂的基数模式前传的需要。

blocks.zh: 我们使用NVIDIA DGX B200 GPU进行训练,在各种模式条件下总共需要185 GPU小时.

blocks.en: A.4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: A.4 评价

blocks.en: In Table 6 we report the average number of active features per example (L0) and fraction of variance unexplained (FVU) achieved by our fine-tuned SAEs across each layer on their respective validation sets. We see that on average the fine-tuned model SAEs have much lower L0 and reconstruction error than the base model SAEs. This is despite the fact that in our main results, the base model SAEs performed far better on the downstream generated text detection task. This echoes findings from Karvonen et al. (2025) that show simple reconstruction-based evaluations for SAEs can fail to correlate with actual desired downstream effects.
blocks.zh: 在表6中,我们报告每个实例(L0)的平均活性特征数量,以及我们经过微调的SAE在每一层实现的差异(FVU)在它们各自的验证组上的比例。 我们看到,平均来说,经过微调的型号SAE的L0和重建误差比底号SAE低得多. 尽管在我们的主要结果中,底模SAE在下游生成的文本检测任务上的表现要好得多。 这与Karvonen等人(2025年)的调查结果相呼应,这些结论显示,对SAE进行简单的基于重建的评价可能无法与预期下游的实际效果联系起来。

blocks.en: We also observe that the fine-tuned model SAEs gradually exhibit lower L0 as we go deeper in the model. This is in contrast to the base model SAEs which roughly have similar L0 regardless of depth. This hints at potential ways in which fine-tuned models may process information internally in fundamentally different ways than base models. While a full deep dive into the representational dynamics of these models is beyond the scope of this work, we nonetheless think this is a potentially promising direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们还观察到,微调的型号SAEs在我们更深入的型号中逐渐显示出较低的L0. 这与基型SAE形成对比,无论深度如何,其L0大致相似. 这暗示了微调模型以与基础模型根本不同的方式处理内部信息的潜在方式. 虽然对这些模型的代表性动态进行充分深入的探索超出了这项工作的范围,但我们认为,这是未来工作的一个有希望的方向。

blocks.en: Because raw SAE max activations span several orders of magnitude, we normalize each feature by its root-mean-square (RMS) over the training corpus before training. Scaling without centering keeps zero activations at zero, preserving sparsity, and means the L1 penalty acts in standardized feature space. For our gram2vec baseline, whose features are dense rates rather than sparse activations, we instead fully standardize via z-scoring ( ( x − μ ) / σ (x-\mu)/\sigma ). In both cases the normalization is folded back into the saved weights and bias after training, so the resulting detectors operate directly on raw features.
blocks.zh: 由于原始的SAE最大激活量跨越多个数量级,所以在训练前,我们通过它的根-正方位(RMS)使每个特征都正常化。 在不居中的情况下放大使零激活保持在零,保留了sparsity,并指标准化特征空间中的L1惩罚行为. 我们的gram2vec基线的特征是密集率,而不是稀疏的激活率,我们则通过z-评分(x-μ) / ç(x-\mu)/\sigma来完全标准化。 在这两种情况下,正常化都会在训练后折回所节省的重量和偏差,因此由此产生的探测器直接在原始特性上运行.

blocks.en: To cut down on inference time, we cached max pooled activations for each SAE for each document in the training data as memory-mapped arrays on disk, gathering only the rows needed for each minibatch. This allowed us to skip having to do any forward passes of language models during training, allowing us to efficiently train on CPU.

blocks.en: We train these models as a comparison point for the logistic regression, to see whether or not our features have large interaction terms that the logistic regression is not taking advantage of. However, in general we note that our logistic regression classifiers do about as well as XGBoost, indicating that our features are primarily additive with minimal interaction terms. blocks.en: C.1 Processing

blocks.en: The PRDB dataset Yu et al. (2026) consists of human and AI generated peer review text from NeurIPS and ICLR for the previous 8 years (2016-2024). During that time period, the structure of peer reviews has changed. In the early years, reviewers were often given just a single text box to write their review. However, recently conferences have been breaking up the review into different sections (e.g. “Summary of Contributions”, “Strengths and Weaknesses”, “Questions”). PRDB respects these sections and separates the text of reviews into different columns based on the section they come from. This requires us to decide on a standardized format to use when converting a peer review with multiple text fields into a pure text document.
blocks.zh: PRDB 数据集 余等编. (2026)包括前8年(2016年-2024年)NeurIPS和ICLR生成的人文和AI同行评审文本. 在此期间,同行审查的结构发生了变化。 早年,审查者往往只得到一个文本框来撰写审查. 但是,最近召开的会议将审查分成不同的部分(例如,“会费概要”、“稳定和弱点”、“问题”)。 PRDB尊重这些章节,并根据它们来自的章节将评论文本分为不同的栏目. 这要求我们决定一种标准格式,在将具有多个文本字段的同行评审转换成纯文本文档时使用.
对于每个具有多个字段的文档,我们取字段的名称(例如摘要_of_the_paper),去掉下划线并将其转换为标题大小写. 然后在左侧和右侧插入双星号,以模拟一个粗体的Markdown标题,并在之后直接添加每个部分的原始文本. 这是用一个非常快速而简单的衬线f“\ title{n{value.strip()}\\ n”完成的。

blocks.en: Given that both human written and AI generated peer reviews are required to conform to this structure, adding these Markdown elements does not add any formatting artifacts that would be easily exploitable by our detectors. On the contrary, this artificially reduces the predictive power of any markdown-based features. We do this intentionally to bias our models towards using more substantive features for detection.
blocks.zh: 鉴于人类书面和人工智能生成的同行评审都必须符合这一结构,添加这些Markdown元素不会添加任何易于我们探测器利用的格式化文物. 相反,这人为地降低了任何减速特征的预测力. 我们这样做是为了使我们的模型偏向于使用更实质性的特征来检测。

blocks.en: In Figure 11 and Figure 13 we report the full text of the prompts used in the description generation and validation portions of our pipeline respectively. During generation we ask the model to provide three different flavors of description: one terse, one keyword-based, and one long. For all experiments and validation in our work we always use the terse description and ignore the keyword and long variants. The latter are only used when visualizing features in our interface (§ F ).
blocks.zh: 在图11和图13中,我们分别报告我们管道描述生成和验证部分所用的提示全文。 在一代人中,我们要求模型提供三种不同的描述口味:一种三重音,一种关键词,一种长音。 对于我们工作中的所有实验和验证,我们总是使用terse描述而忽略关键词和长变体. 后者仅在我们界面中可视化特性时使用(§F).

blocks.en: In Figure 12 we show an example of how documents are formatted in our description generation prompt. We provide the language model with an extended list of documents from across the feature’s activation distribution. For each document we include special angled bracket tokens to indicate on which tokens a feature is most active and crop each document to a small window ( ± \pm 20 tokens) around the max activating token. During description validation we follow the same process but group all documents together in the same bulleted list. For negative documents, during validation, we randomly sample a token as the maximum activating token and highlight and crop as necessary.
blocks.zh: 在图12中,我们展示了一个实例,说明我们如何在描述生成时及时格式化文件。 我们向语言模型提供一份扩展的列表,该列表来自该功能的激活分发。 对于每个文档,我们包含特殊的角括号符号,以表示一个特性最活跃的符号,并且将每个文档剪切到最大激活符号周围的小窗口(±\pm 20个符号)。 在描述验证过程中,我们遵循同一程序,但将所有文件合并到同一个圆形列表中。 对于负面文档,在验证过程中,我们随机抽取一个符号作为最大激活符号,并在必要时突出并裁剪.

blocks.en: E.1 Feature-Level Paraphrase Ablation
blocks.zh: E.1 特性级参数化

blocks.en: Figure 14 gives the full prompt. It includes all three components of the feature description (terse summary, keywords, detailed description) and instructs the model to change only the target feature.
blocks.zh: 图14给出了全速。 它包含了特征描述的所有三个组成部分(terse摘要,关键词,详细描述),并指示模型只改变目标特征.

blocks.en: For each dataset we draw a class-balanced sample of 1,000 documents (500 human, 500 AI) from the held-out test split with a fixed seed. On PRDB the AI class is the detector’s target generator (GPT-4o); on COLING, where detectors are trained on all generators pooled, AI documents are sampled from every generator in proportion to its share of the corpus.
blocks.zh: 对于每个数据集,我们从搁置测试中抽取1,000份文件(500份人类文件,500份AI文件)的分类平衡样本,用固定种子进行分解. 在PRDB上,AI类是探测器的目标生成器(GPT-4o);在COLING上,探测器对所有发电机集合进行训练,AI文件按照每个发电机在机体中所占份额的比例进行取样。

blocks.en: For each document we compute the zero-ablation logit delta of every active feature receiving weight in the head (in the w/ Mask condition only features with simulation score above 0.7 0.7 can be active) and uniformly sample up to 50 of them, without replacement, as paraphrase targets. Sampling is restricted to describable features, i.e., those with an auto-interp description and a defined simulation score; this excludes features too rare for auto-interp to run and a small set of document-start artifacts whose descriptions cannot guide an edit. Sampling is seeded per document. This yields roughly 40,000–50,000 (document, feature) rewrite records per configuration.
blocks.zh: 对于每个文档,我们计算每个在头部接受权重的活性特性的零比对数三角洲(在w/Mask条件中,只有模拟分数超过0.7的特性才能活性),并统一抽取多达50个,没有替换,作为参数指标. 抽样仅限于可贬低的特性,即那些具有自动对讲描述和定义模拟分数的特性;这排除了对于自动对讲操作来说太罕见的特性,以及一小组无法指导编辑的文档启动文物. 每份文件都进行取样。 这大约产生40 000至50 000(文件、特性)重写每个配置的记录。

blocks.en: Logit deltas are measured in log-odds space with a consistent sign convention. The activation shifts Δ tgt \Delta_{\text{tgt}} and Δ non \Delta_{\text{non}} are the absolute change in a feature’s activation between original and rewrite, normalized by that feature’s mean activation over the training corpus (so 1.0 1.0 is a shift equal to its typical activation); Δ tgt \Delta_{\text{tgt}} is this quantity for the targeted feature and Δ non \Delta_{\text{non}} its mean over all other active features. Per-feature analyses exclude features with | Ablate ​ Δ | < 0.01 |\text{Ablate }\Delta|<0.01 or sampled in fewer than 10 documents.
blocks.zh: logit deltas在log-odds空间中进行测量,并有一个一致的标志协议. tgt\Delta\text{tgt}和\delta\text{non}是一个特性在原始和重写之间的激活的绝对变化,由该特性在训练程序上的平均激活而正常化(所以1.01.0是一个等同于其典型激活的转变);\ tgt\delta\text{tgt}是目标特性和\delta\text{non}的这个数量。 它的恶毒 在所有其它活跃的特征。 按地貌进行的分析排除了带有`Ablate Δ < 0.01 |\ Text{Ablate }\Delta|<0.01 或样本不足10份文件的特征。

blocks.en: Figure 9 plots each feature’s zero-ablation delta against its paraphrase delta for every head: agreement is moderate on COLING ( ρ = 0.36 \rho=0.36 – 0.62 0.62 ), strong on PRDB ( 0.69 0.69 – 0.81 0.81 ), and higher with the mask in every setting. Table 10 bins features by auto-interp score; ρ \rho rises from 0.78 0.78 in the lowest quartile to 0.87 0.87 in the highest, so better-described features are edited away more precisely. Tables 13 and 14 list the most frequently targeted features. On PRDB rewrites are precise ( Δ tgt \Delta_{\text{tgt}} typically 0.5 0.5 – 1.0 1.0 , Δ non \Delta_{\text{non}} 0.02 0.02 – 0.3 0.3 ); on COLING the base-model SAEs’ most common features are punctuation and sentence-boundary detectors that a meaning-preserving rewrite can rarely remove, which accounts for the weaker agreement.

blocks.en: E.2 Document-Level Paraphrase Ablation
blocks.zh: E.2 文档级别参数

blocks.en: We attack the τ > 0.85 \tau>0.85 logistic-regression heads of all three feature settings on COLING and PRDB (Llama-trained heads in Figure 5 ; GPT-4o-trained heads as a robustness check). Each detector uses the Youden threshold of its development-set evaluation, fixed before the attack; we verified that this reproduces its reported F1. Per dataset we draw 2,500 AI and 2,500 human documents with a fixed seed (30–900 Gemma tokens, so paraphrases fit the 1,024-token extractor window), shared by the dataset’s three detectors; PRDB AI documents come from the target generator only. Only AI documents are paraphrased, so false positives are held fixed and F1 moves only through recall.
blocks.zh: 我们攻击COLLING和PRDB上所有三个特性设置的 > 0.85\tau>0.85后勤后退头(图5中的Llama训练头;GPT-4o训练头作为坚固性检查). 每个探测器都使用攻击前固定的Youden开发设定评价的阈值;我们核实这复制了其报告的F1. 每个数据集,我们绘制2500 AI和2500个人类文件,带有固定的种子(30-900 Gemma令牌,所以配上1 024个托肯提取器窗口),由数据集的三个探测器共享;PRDB AI文件仅来自目标生成器. 只有AI文档被解释,所以假阳性被固定,F1只通过召回移动.

blocks.en: The three unguided prompts (Figures 15 – 17 ) are generated once per dataset and scored by all of its detectors; they share an edit budget of “well under 20%” of the words. Few Shot draws three human training-split documents per target from the same sub-source (COLING) or conference (PRDB), length-matched and, for PRDB, from papers absent from the test split. Guided adds six generic rules against machine-writing habits written from general knowledge, independent of any detector. The SAE prompt (Figures 18 , 19 ) is detector-specific: it lists the ten largest AI-direction and ten largest human-direction feature contributions with their descriptions, keywords, signed contributions and the three passages where each fires most strongly, states the max-pooling counting rule, sets a target equal to the score’s distance above the threshold plus 3, and asks for a plan before the rewrite. SAE × 3 \times 3 repeats this up to three times, recomputing the evidence on each rewrite and re-prompting only documents still classified as AI; a document is frozen at the first pass that flips. Failed generations were rare (0–6 per condition) and are excluded.
blocks.zh: 3个无制导提示(图15 – 17)每个数据集生成一次,并由所有探测器打分;它们共享“远远低于20%”的编辑预算。 数目 Shoot从同一个子来源(COLING)或会议(PRDB)中抽取三个人类训练分散文件,长度匹配,对于PRDB来说,则从没有参加测试分裂的论文中抽取. 指南增加了六条通用规则,禁止从一般知识中写作的机器写作习惯,独立于任何探测器. SAE 提示(图 18, 19)是针对探测器的:它列出了十大AI方向和十大人类方向特征贡献,并附有其描述,关键词,签名贡献以及每个点火最强烈的三段,规定了最大集合计数规则,设定了等于分数距离超过阈值+3的目标,并在重写前要求计划. SAE × 3\times 3 重复了最多3次,在每次重写上重编证据,并重制只有仍然归类为AI的文件;在第一个翻转的通过时,一个文件被冻结. 失败的几代人很少(每代0-6人),被排除在外。

blocks.en: F1 at the frozen threshold with human scores fixed; attack success rate (ASR), the share of base-detected AI documents classified human after the attack; and Lev, the word-level Levenshtein distance to the original as a share of the longer text. For SAE × 3 \times 3 all quantities are measured on the text at which a document was frozen, so Lev is cumulative. Uncertainty is a 1,000-sample bootstrap over AI documents. Table 23 reports all metrics for every detector and condition.
blocks.zh: F1在被冻结的阈值上设定了人类的分数;攻击成功率(ASR),基础探测的AI文件在攻击后将人类分类的比例;和列夫,单词级的列文斯提因距离与原始的距离作为较长文本的一部分. 对于SAE × 3\times 3,所有量都用一个文件被冻结的文本来测量,所以Lev是累积的. 不确定是人工智能文档上的一个1000个样本的靴子 表23报告每个探测器和条件的所有度量。

blocks.en: The feature-guided attack is also the most economical: one SAE pass edits 6–29% of words and three passes 11–38%, against 24–39% for the unguided prompts, while flipping two to ten times as many documents. The one exception is FT-SAE on PRDB (ASR 3.4% after one pass, 21.8% after three), whose evidence is spread over about 150 densely firing base-model features that no ten-feature list captures. The GPT-4o-trained PRDB heads behave like the Llama-trained ones (ASR after three passes 69%, 20%, 83% vs. 60%, 22%, 97%), so the conclusions do not depend on the generator. Because the attack only needs to cross the frozen threshold, AUROC degrades far less than F1 (e.g., 0.96 to 0.82 for FT-Model+SAE on COLING).
blocks.zh: 特性引导攻击也是最经济的:一个SAE通过编辑的字数为6–29%,三个通过11–38%,而非定向提示为24–39%,同时翻转的文件数是2–10倍. 一个例外是PRDB上的FT-SAE(一次过后为3.4%,三次过后为21.8%),其证据分布在大约150个密集射击基型特征上,没有十层的列表捕获. GPT-4训练的PRDB头像Llama训练的头像(经过3次之后的ASR为69%,20%,83%对60%,22%,97%),因此结论并不依赖于生成器. 由于攻击只需要越过冷冻阈值,AUROC的降解量远小于F1(例如,在COLING上FT-Model+SAE的降解量为0.96到0.82).

Once the user hits enter, we run the base model, extract SAE activations from the four hook points, and run the classification head to get the final prediction.

blocks.en: In Figure 20 we report the AUROC scores for our different conditions for various interpretability thresholds on the RAID dataset. We observe that the FT-Model+SAE condition seems to roughly match the performance of the full neural baseline for most conditions and that both the Base-SAE and FT-SAE perform better on models present in the COLING dataset.

blocks.en: In Table 25 we report evaluation results on the PRDB dataset. We see that training on Llama generally leads to worse performance on the three held out models (Qwen, Claude, and Gemini). We suspect that this may be due to Llama sharing fewer specific stylistic tendencies with other comparable models. Previous work by Jiang et al. (2026) has noted the surprising degree of stylistic similarity across different language models. We hope that these types of SAE-based feature analyses may give us a more precise vocabulary for describing the subtle differences between models.
blocks.zh: 在表25中,我们报告了PRDB数据集的评价结果。 我们看到,关于Llama的培训通常导致三个被搁置的模型(Quen、Claude和双子座)的成绩更差。 我们怀疑这可能是因为Llama与其他可比模型分享的具体风格倾向较少. 江等人先前的著作(2026年)指出,不同语言模式的语气相似程度惊人. 我们希望,这些类型的基于SAE的特征分析可以给我们一个更精确的词汇来描述模型之间的微妙差异.

blocks.en: AI assistants were used to implement the interface in section F , write the initial drafts of the introduction and abstract, and gather initial collections of related work for literature review. We also used AI frequently in smaller less autonomous capacities such as when brainstorming the organization of information in this paper, writing specific self-contained functions, creating tables and visualizations, and adding documentation to our codebase.
blocks.zh: AI助手被用于实施F节中的界面,撰写介绍和抽象的初稿,并收集相关作品的初始集,以供文献审查. 我们还经常以较小的自主能力使用AI,例如当集思广益地整理本文中的信息时,写具体自成一体的功能,创建表格和可视化,以及在我们的代码库中添加文件时.

blocks.en: We used Gemini 2.5 Pro for everyday questions and Claude Opus 4.7 for larger more agentic tasks. Wherever possible, in our code, we indicate when AI assistants were involved with comments.
